objects.description: A small, value-semantic identifier class in namespace ESM that wraps a 64-bit unsigned integer to represent a generated reference ID. Provides value retrieval, string/debug conversions (declared here, defined elsewhere), comparison operators, stream output (friend), and a std::hash specialization for use in unordered containers.

functions.name: ESM::GeneratedRefId::GeneratedRefId
functions.description: Constructs a GeneratedRefId from a 64-bit unsigned integer value. Intended to wrap a generated reference identifier into a strong type usable in containers, comparisons, and I/O. Details about valid ranges or semantics of the value are not documented in this header.
requirements: value must be representable as a std::uint64_t (implicit by type)
Object may be constructed in a constexpr context; constructor does not throw (noexcept)

functions.name: ESM::GeneratedRefId::getValue
functions.description: Returns the underlying 64-bit value of the GeneratedRefId. Use when raw numeric access is needed (e.g., serialization or interop).
requirements: Can be called on a const instance
Callable in a constexpr context

functions.name: ESM::GeneratedRefId::toString
functions.description: Returns a string representation of the identifier. Exact format is not specified in this header; presumed to be a human-readable form suitable for display or serialization.
requirements: Requires a valid, initialized instance
Allocation may occur; caller should expect potential exceptions from std::string allocation

functions.name: ESM::GeneratedRefId::toDebugString
functions.description: Returns a debug-oriented string representation of the identifier. Exact contents/format are not specified; likely includes additional detail helpful for debugging.
requirements: Requires a valid, initialized instance
Allocation may occur; caller should expect potential exceptions from std::string allocation

functions.name: ESM::GeneratedRefId::operator==
functions.description: Compares two GeneratedRefId values for equality based on their underlying 64-bit value.
requirements: Both operands must be valid GeneratedRefId instances
No exceptions are thrown (noexcept)
Usable in constexpr context

functions.name: ESM::GeneratedRefId::operator<
functions.description: Provides a strict-weak ordering based on the underlying 64-bit value, enabling use in ordered containers and sorting.
requirements: Both operands must be valid GeneratedRefId instances
No exceptions are thrown (noexcept)
Usable in constexpr context

functions.name: operator<<
functions.description: Streams a textual representation of the GeneratedRefId to the provided std::ostream. The exact format is unspecified here and matches toString()/debug output policy as implemented elsewhere.
requirements: stream must be a valid std::ostream reference ready for output
May perform allocation internally depending on formatting; callers should expect potential exceptions related to I/O or allocation
Returns the provided stream to allow chaining

functions.name: std::hash<ESM::GeneratedRefId>::operator()
functions.description: Computes a hash value for a GeneratedRefId using the hash of its underlying 64-bit value. Suitable for use in unordered containers.
requirements: Callable in constant time; does not throw (noexcept)
The same input value yields the same hash within a process execution
No preconditions beyond providing a valid GeneratedRefId
